title: wt
description: Human Lineage MCP server — search and query the public genealogical graph of all humanity
summary: Human Lineage MCP server — search and query the public genealogical graph of all humanity
offersHint: Human Lineage MCP server — search and query the public genealogical graph of all humanity · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://humanlineage.org/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_person
toolsPreview.description: Search the Human Lineage genealogical graph for a person by name. Returns matches with their profile URL.

toolsPreview.name: get_person
toolsPreview.description: Get full details for a person by their Human Lineage ID, including a link to their profile.

toolsPreview.name: get_relatives
toolsPreview.description: Get the immediate family (parents, children, spouses) of a person as TEXT, with profile URLs. Use get_family_image instead if the user wants to see a picture/visual/graphic of the family tree.

toolsPreview.name: get_family_image
toolsPreview.description: Returns a markdown image (![...](url)) of a visual family-tree card showing a person's parents, spouse and children. Use this — not get_relatives — whenever the user asks to see, show, view, or display a family tree, family diagram, or picture of the family. IMPORTANT: include the returned markdown image line verbatim in your reply so it renders for the user.

toolsPreview.name: search_place
toolsPreview.description: Search the Human Lineage genealogical graph for a place by name. Returns matches with their place URL.

toolsPreview.name: get_place
toolsPreview.description: Get details for a place by its Human Lineage ID, including its hierarchy and recorded person count.
